For legacy raw Gerbers: absolute millimetre 3.3/4.6 data, explicit positive legacy polarity/name metadata, no registration fit; flat imported-graphic count filter then full ordered-image correspondence to fresh source plots. First native source gate independently reparses qualified originals against another fresh native plot with recorded input precision and arc bounds plus three correspondence corruptions. setup: Same project-local macOS native launcher, updated once per session. Automatic file-message intake for every explicit directory; no embedded source-folder access, per-directory setup, OS self-grant, MCP, network, install or global configuration. failure: HALTED with retained native request/response evidence even before job allocation; OS access errors carry errno/path. No rendering fallback, input substitution, shortened source, retries, policy edits or acceptance promotion.
terminal: COMPLETE_AUDITED_BOARD_EXPORT_SEQUENCE after all eighteen accepted observations. Return ready_markdown at REPORT_AND_STOP and stop. Completed-report retrieval verifies retained hashes without reexecution.
